title.zh-CN: 用药后红斑迅速发展为大疱与表皮脱落
title.en: A rash progressing to blisters and skin detachment after medication

summary.zh-CN: 儿童驱虫用药后出现快速扩展皮损，随后又接受多种药物，需重建时间线并识别皮肤屏障急症。
summary.en: A child develops a rapidly spreading eruption after deworming treatment, followed by additional medicines, requiring a careful timeline and urgent skin-barrier assessment.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: BAD 2018 paediatric SJS/TEN guideline (2019 publication), checked 2026-10-28; scope specialist assessment, minimising skin trauma and infection-based antibiotics.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别严重皮肤屏障急症。
讨论皮肤保护与再暴露风险。
learningOutcomes.en: Discuss skin protection and re-exposure risks.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 全身瘙痒红斑一天，大疱及表皮剥脱两小时

triageNote.zh-CN: 关注表皮脱落和系统风险，不凭标题填补黏膜或面积资料。
triageNote.en: Assess skin detachment and systemic risk without inventing mucosal findings or surface area.

question.zh-CN: 皮疹前最先用了什么药？

answer.zh-CN: 入院前三天单次口服阿苯达唑驱虫。
answer.en: A single oral albendazole dose for deworming was taken three days before admission.

maneuver.en: Review recorded skin morphology without repeating friction tests

finding.zh-CN: 弥漫大片红斑、松弛水疱、表皮松解和少量糜烂渗液，原文尼氏征阳性；未给脱落体表面积和完整黏膜检查。
finding.en: Diffuse erythema, flaccid bullae, epidermal separation and limited erosive exudation; Nikolsky sign was reported positive. Detached surface area and full mucosal examination were not provided.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前最重要的临床框架是什么？
prompt.en: What is the most important clinical framing?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 严重表皮屏障损伤急症，药物相关反应需与儿童其他大疱病鉴别
text.en: A severe epidermal-barrier emergency, with drug reaction differentiated from other paediatric blistering disorders

feedback.zh-CN: 表皮脱落超出普通荨麻疹范围。
feedback.en: Detachment exceeds an ordinary urticarial reaction.

text.zh-CN: 瘙痒说明只是轻微过敏
text.en: Itching proves only mild allergy

feedback.zh-CN: 大疱和表皮脱落是严重信号。
feedback.en: Bullae and skin loss are severe warning signs.

text.zh-CN: 没有面积资料也能精确分类TEN
text.en: TEN can be precisely classified without area data

feedback.zh-CN: SJS/TEN分层需要实际面积和临床资料。
feedback.en: SJS/TEN classification needs actual surface area and clinical information.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 首药时序支持怀疑阿苯达唑，但多药和缺失病理限制因果与精确分类
text.en: The first-drug timeline supports suspicion of albendazole, but multiple drugs and missing pathology limit causality and classification

feedback.zh-CN: 后加药不能当首发原因，但仍需列入后续评估。
feedback.en: Later drugs cannot explain initial onset but remain relevant to subsequent assessment.

text.zh-CN: 要再次服药才能安全确认
text.en: Re-exposure is required for safe confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 严重皮肤反应不能以无保护再挑战确认。
feedback.en: A severe skin reaction must not be confirmed through unprotected rechallenge.

text.zh-CN: 无既往过敏史可排除药疹
text.en: No previous allergy excludes drug eruption

feedback.zh-CN: 首次严重反应仍可发生。
feedback.en: A first severe reaction can still occur.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前安全处理应强调什么？
prompt.en: What should safe current care emphasise?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 停用可疑非必需药，紧急皮肤与儿科团队评估屏障、眼黏膜、液体和感染风险
text.en: Stop suspected non-essential medicines and obtain urgent dermatology/paediatric assessment of barrier, ocular/mucosal, fluid and infection risks

feedback.zh-CN: 皮肤应减少摩擦，免疫治疗和抗菌药按专科证据与实际感染判断。
feedback.en: Reduce skin friction; immune therapy and antibiotics require specialist assessment and actual infection evidence.

text.zh-CN: 反复摩擦皮肤验证尼氏征
text.en: Repeatedly rub skin to confirm Nikolsky sign

text.zh-CN: 所有患儿照旧文固定大剂量激素和预防抗生素
text.en: Use historical fixed high-dose steroids and prophylactic antibiotics for every child

feedback.zh-CN: 单例疗程不是通用现行规范。
feedback.en: A single historical regimen is not a universal current protocol.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 停止可疑暴露并保护皮肤和黏膜，避免再挑战和摩擦损伤
text.en: Stop suspected exposure and protect skin/mucosa, avoiding rechallenge and friction injury

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明表皮脱落定义紧迫性。；承认缺少脱落面积、黏膜、活检及长期后遗症评估。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Skin detachment establishes urgency.; acknowledge Detached surface area, mucosal assessment, biopsy and long-term sequelae evaluation are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为阿苯达唑相关严重大疱性药疹，现代精确SJS/TEN分类证据不足。
conclusion.en: The source describes an albendazole-associated severe bullous drug eruption with insufficient evidence for precise modern SJS/TEN classification.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 面积和黏膜缺失限制分型。
keyReasoning.en: Missing area and mucosal data limit classification.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不能把缺失黏膜写成无受累。
teachingPoints.en: Missing mucosal data are not absence of involvement.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不重复破坏性体征诱发。
teachingPoints.en: Do not repeatedly provoke destructive signs.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少脱落面积、黏膜、活检及长期后遗症评估。
unknowns.en: Detached surface area, mucosal assessment, biopsy and long-term sequelae evaluation are missing.
